releaseNotes: Public preview SDK for NexatomTT on Windows x64.

Adds a stated end reason for every recording (nexatom_tt_get_saving_result), measurement-abort handling, Fast TIHI and the pulse outputs (DTC) on the UTT160810, time-tag and Fast TIHI export jobs, bootloader-return and link-loss reporting, per-input on/off, reference-clock status and output; examples and manual updated. Rebuild applications against this release's header.

Checked on Windows with the UTT160810 (K168_005) and the UTT810 (Z080_005): on the UTT160810, a Fast TIHI save of four 10 MHz inputs for 10 min (180 GB), raw binary saving at 40 M tags/s for 10 min and raw CSV saving at 40 M tags/s for 60 s, all whole and read back; the Nexatom application connects to both boards.
Firmware catalogue 4 is included in firmware/: Z080_005 (UTT810, FW 0x0104) and K168_005 (UTT160810, FW 0x0005) are current and need this SDK line; Z080_004 and K168_004 are kept as superseded.
